faq.visa.TH: Usually 30 days, depending on your passport. Nomad Spin lists Thailand's Tourism Visa Exemption at 30 days for 60 countries and territories (effective 15 Sep 2026); a few get 15 days or visa on arrival. For longer stays, look at the Destination Thailand Visa. Verify on official Thai government pages.
faq.visa.VN: Up to {days} days on Vietnam's E-Visa, per Nomad Spin's data. It is an application-based visa, so apply before you travel and check the length printed on the visa you are granted. Verify current eligibility and validity on {source} before you book.
faq.visa.stayVisaFree: Up to {days} days for many passports. Nomad Spin lists visa-free entry for {country}; eligibility and length depend on your nationality. {extra} Verify current rules with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.stayOnArrival: Up to {days} days for many passports. Nomad Spin lists a visa on arrival for {country}; eligibility and length depend on your nationality. {extra} Verify current rules with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.remoteWorkCheck: Check whether remote work is allowed on that entry.
faq.visa.application: Up to {days} days on the initial {type}, per Nomad Spin's data. It is an application-based route, so eligibility, income rules and renewals vary by applicant. {shortVisits} Verify current requirements with {source} before you apply.
faq.visa.shortVisits: Short visits without it follow normal entry rules.
faq.visa.fallback: Up to {days} days on the {type}, per Nomad Spin's data. Eligibility depends on your passport. Verify current rules on {source}.
faq.visa.rulesChange: Rules change, so read the official page again before you travel.
faq.visa.extra.TW: For a longer remote-work stay, Taiwan also issues a Digital Nomad Visa.
faq.visa.extra.KR: For a longer remote-work stay, Korea offers the F-1-D Workation visa.
faq.visa.extra.JP: Japan also has a separate digital nomad status under Designated Activities.
faq.visa.extra.CL: Chile has no dedicated digital nomad visa, so longer stays need another residence route.
faq.visa.extra.CO: Migracion Colombia can extend that permit within a yearly cap.
faq.visa.extra.TR: Longer stays need a short-term residence permit.
faq.visa.rule.DE: Up to {days} days for many passports, counted across the whole Schengen area. For a longer stay, Germany has a freelance residence permit, and the local immigration office sets its length. Verify current requirements with {source} before you apply.
faq.visa.rule.PL: Up to {days} days for many passports, counted across the whole Schengen area. Poland has no dedicated digital nomad visa, so a longer stay needs a national visa or residence permit for another purpose. Verify current rules with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.rule.MX: Up to {days} days for many passports, but the immigration officer decides how many days you get. Nomad Spin lists visa-free entry for Mexico. Longer stays need temporary residence through a Mexican consulate. Verify current rules with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.rule.BR: Up to {days} days for many passports, but US, Canadian and Australian citizens need an e-visa first. For a longer remote-work stay, Brazil offers the VITEM XIV digital nomad visa. Verify current rules with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.rule.BG: Up to {days} days for many passports, counted across the Schengen area, which Bulgaria has fully joined. For a longer stay, Bulgaria now offers a digital nomad residence permit that starts with a long-stay visa. Verify current rules with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.rule.GR: Up to {days} days for many passports, counted across the whole Schengen area. For a longer remote-work stay, Greece offers a Digital Nomad Visa of up to 1 year, then a residence permit. Verify current rules with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.rule.HR: Up to {days} days for many passports, counted across the whole Schengen area. For a longer remote-work stay, Croatia grants digital nomads a temporary stay of up to 18 months. Verify current rules with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.rule.ES: Up to {days} days for many passports, counted across the whole Schengen area. For a longer remote-work stay, Spain's digital nomad visa runs up to 1 year, and an in-country telework permit up to 3 years (Ley 14/2013). Verify current rules on official Spanish government pages.
faq.visa.rule.PT: Up to {days} days for many passports, counted across the whole Schengen area. For a longer remote-work stay, Portugal has a temporary-stay visa of up to 1 year, or a residence visa that leads to a 2-year residence permit (Lei 23/2007). Verify current rules on official MNE and AIMA pages.
faq.visa.rule.MY: Up to {days} days for many passports, depending on nationality. For a longer remote-work stay, Malaysia runs the DE Rantau Nomad Pass, a separate application. Verify current rules with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.rule.AL: Up to {days} days in any 180 for most visa-free passports under Law 79/2021; a few passports get longer. For a longer remote-work stay, Albania offers a one-year unique permit for digital mobile workers. Verify your passport with {source} before you book.
faq.visa.rule.ME: Up to {days} days in any 180 for most visa-free passports, counted from the date of first entry. Longer stays need a long-stay visa or a residence permit. Verify your passport with {source} before you book.
